profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Skyworks Solutions, Inc.

positions.title: Validation Software Intern
positions.description:
Migrated the team's Jenkins server from a Windows desktop to an Ubuntu virtual environment with a new job distribution system.

Created the ground works for a plugin that ran in parallel with the team's automated test system.  The plugin used an abstract syntax tree to convert scripts for the test system into Verilog scripts which allow for system level verification tests and validation tests pre-silicon bringup.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Created Python Tklnter program to enhance Ixia’s Visibility and Security product line automation  library.  The Python program wrote to Ixia’s traffic generator Tcl API manipulated Ethernet header variables and validated received packet count and traffic profile matched expected transmit. 

•Helped integrate the Python program into a new automation harness built off of Robot Frameworks

positions.title: System Test Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Created a Java program that automated writing the automation test scripts and the charting of test metrics
•Worked on a proof of concept for a software based alternative for a binary CAM chip  
•Restructured the test case data base  
•Participated in the Ixia 2015 Hackathon that whiteboard designed a new look up using trie data structure
